# Param Kisan

> Param Kisan (tagline: "Farmers Trust, Family First") sells farm-direct natural jaggery cubes, turmeric powder and Byadagi chilli powder. Products have no added colour and are sold on Amazon.in. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/param.kisan/

Purchasing happens on Amazon.in. Use the product links below to order. Prices and stock are shown live on Amazon and are not listed here.

## Single products (buy on Amazon.in)

- [Natural Jaggery Cubes](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H837MKY8): natural cane jaggery cubes, no bleaching or added colour.
- [Natural Turmeric Powder 100g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H82ZDRBS): finely milled turmeric powder, rich colour and aroma, no added colour.
- [Byadagi Chilli Powder 100g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H835DXRZ): GI-tagged Byadagi chilli powder with deep red colour and fragrant heat.

## Combos (buy on Amazon.in)

- [Turmeric, Chilli & Jaggery Trio Combo 690g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H83FZLZC): turmeric 100g, Byadagi chilli 100g and jaggery cubes 490g.
- [Chilli & Jaggery Combo 590g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H83NJCS3): Byadagi chilli with jaggery cubes.
- [Turmeric & Jaggery Combo 590g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H832GR81): turmeric 100g with jaggery 490g.
- [Turmeric & Byadagi Chilli Combo 200g](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0H82QJDDH): turmeric 100g with GI-tagged Byadagi chilli 100g.
